    Muscle synergy characteristics of pumping in Chinese elite windsurfers
    Scientific Reports · 2026

    一句话结论：It is revealed that elite windsurfers employ four consistent muscle synergies during pumping, with phase-specific lateral asymmetries in muscle contributions and a stable activation hierarchy.
